## DecodeContext interface

What a client supplies when decoding wire values into SDK values.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface DecodeContext
```

## Remarks

References and file values are live objects bound to the client that decoded them, so resolving or fetching follows that client's locality (local runtime or remote service) without separate APIs. Binders receive decoded data, never wire encodings: the value type has already validated the wire form and decoded every nested value.
